title: AERS-Pro: code, PII-masked corpus and per-sample predictions for Vietnamese e-commerce sentiment analysis
description:
Research artifact accompanying the manuscript A Hybrid Machine Learning Framework for Vietnamese Sentiment Analysis in E-Commerce (manuscript QNUJS-B2662, under review at the Journal of Science - Quy Nhon University).

AERS-Pro is a stacking ensemble for three-class (negative / neutral / positive) Vietnamese review sentiment. It combines word TF-IDF, hashed character n-grams, lexicon and part-of-speech features, out-of-fold stacking of logistic regression, LinearSVC and LightGBM base learners, and conditional probability calibration. It is compared with a fine-tuned PhoBERT baseline over 10 seeds using group-aware (near-duplicate-safe) 60/20/20 splits.

Contents: source code; a PII-masked corpus of 25,289 Vietnamese e-commerce reviews (phone numbers, URLs and social-media handles replaced by placeholders; personal names and addresses were not screened); per-sample predictions of both systems for all 10 seeds (row index, label, logits or probabilities; no review text); split audits; statistical tables (Nadeau-Bengio corrected tests, TOST, Holm adjustment); training logs; SHA-256 manifest. Review texts were collected from a public e-commerce platform for non-commercial research; the corpus is provided for research use only.
